question: When Groq users have both an Enterprise API key and a console browser session, which data source should `auto` select after upgrade?
rationale: The two sources expose different user-visible information, and the PR intentionally changes the default for an existing configured workflow; code correctness alone cannot establish the desired product contract.

options.title: Use credential-aware ordering
options.body: Prefer Prometheus for configured API-key users and console usage for users without a key, preserving upgrades while enabling standard accounts.

options.title: Adopt console-first globally
options.body: Accept that `auto` replaces the existing Enterprise metrics view whenever a browser session is available and document and prove that migration.

options.title: Require explicit web mode
options.body: Keep the existing API behavior as the default and expose console usage only when users deliberately select the web source.

recommendation.title: Use credential-aware ordering
recommendation.body: Prefer Prometheus for configured API-key users and console usage for users without a key, preserving upgrades while enabling standard accounts.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the shipped Groq provider contract and default user experience, making the repository owner the best available decision owner.
